text: The no-argument nsMsgSearchScopeTerm constructor sets m_attribute to zero, m_folder and m_searchSession to null, and m_searchServer to true. nsMsgSearchScope defines offlineMail as zero. GetInputStream separately requires a folder. Recommend using the named scope or documenting the setup requirement when changing this constructor; zero is not automatically an invalid/unset enum sentinel. This is source and test-code inspection. Complete Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.
title: A zero search-scope default is a real enum value
